title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 108 North Macon Street in Bevier, Missouri, as the "SO2 Navy SEAL Adam Olin Smith Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 108 North Macon Street in Bevier, Missouri, as the "SO2 Navy SEAL Adam Olin Smith Post Office."

summary.headline: Names the Bevier, Missouri post office at 108 North Macon Street after Navy SEAL Adam Olin Smith.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility in Bevier, Missouri, located at 108 North Macon Street. The building will be called the "SO2 Navy SEAL Adam Olin Smith Post Office." It is a commemorative designation and does not change how the post office operates.
